title: My New Year Resolutions
subtitle: 考点：目标与计划 / mini-goals / keep on doing
passage: Liu Yang is thirteen. At the start of this year, he made three resolutions: to keep healthy, to read more books and to learn to swim. At first, the goals felt too big, so his father told him to make mini-goals.

To stay healthy, Liu Yang does ten push-ups every morning and goes to bed before ten. After a month, he can do twenty push-ups. To read more, he finishes one page of an English book each night. By June, he had finished four books. To learn swimming, he takes a class every Saturday.

Sometimes Liu Yang feels tired and wants to stop. But he reminds himself, “Keep on trying and stick to the plan.” His father says small steps can lead to big changes. Liu Yang is proud of himself. He is now thinking about new goals for next year.
vocab: resolution 决心 · mini-goal 小目标 · push-up 俯卧撑 · stick to 坚持 · keep on doing 继续做 · achieve 实现 · proud 自豪的
